name: WebGen-Bench
description: WebGen-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate LLM-based agents on their ability to generate multi-file, interactive, and functional website codebases from scratch. It includes 647 test cases derived from diverse website generation instructions covering various web application types, with automated testing via a web-navigation agent to verify functionality.
reputation: A recent benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on end-to-end website generation, with growing interest but limited evidence of broad community standardization so far.
notes: Test cases are generated and filtered using GPT-4o and executed by a web-navigation agent; benchmark highlights challenges in generating functional websites from scratch.
